name: Scissors
stable: Pelvis and spine, held up by the hands
summary: Up on the shoulders with the hands under the hips, the straight legs split away from each other and switch.
steps: Roll over and prop the pelvis on the hands, elbows on the mat, legs to the ceiling.
Reach one leg over the head as the other reaches away towards the mat.
Pulse once, then switch with long legs.
Bring the legs together and roll down one bone at a time.

layers.title: Hold the prop, legs still
layers.text: Find the balance on the shoulders before the legs move.

layers.title: Small splits
layers.text: Legs open a short way and switch.

layers.title: Full splits with a pulse
layers.text: The back leg reaches further than feels natural.

cautions.note: Weight is on the shoulders and upper back.
Inverted and loaded through the abdominals.
Inverted and loaded through the abdominals.
Loaded flexion on the upper spine.
The hands carry the pelvis. Use fists or leave it out.

cues:
Weight on the shoulders, never the neck.
Hips stay still while the legs move.
The leg going away works harder than the one coming in.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
